## Limitations

- Search indexing may be incomplete, change during the round and limit each query to 1,000 results; totals do not represent the population.
- Code search considers only the default branch and files up to 384 KB. Search excludes forks by default.
- Counts are neither prevalence nor confirmed cases: discovery finds candidates and does not determine whether they belong to the phenomenon studied.
- Branches and heads are observed at different times, without a global GitHub snapshot. A commit may become visible after its ref is observed; inspectionUntil fixes the temporal ceiling, not ref visibility. Head changes during pagination and refs created after enumeration do not guarantee retroactive coverage.
- Deleted refs, inaccessible histories and refs from external forks are not supported. Negative coverage applies only to observed refs and pages, not all possible history.
- The commit author, not the committer, determines authorship; committedDate defines the inclusive UTC interval. Human authorship is independent of merges, auto-merges, rebases and cherry-picks.
- Unavailable rate-limit cost and bytes remain null; global counters do not permit inference of per-request cost.
